meta.notes: Base $/m² GFA per building subtype: Altus Group 2026 Canadian Cost Guide (pp. 5–6), the average of the GTA and Ottawa ranges converted from $/sq ft (×10.7639); typical = midpoint. Hard construction costs only: excludes land, soft costs, taxes, contingencies, FF&E, parking and site works. Figures transcribed from Precedent Developments' republication of the guide (retrieved 2026-09-26). Quality factors, sustainability and roof premiums and special spaces are still sample values.
